comparison.objective: Lay two cables into a robot cable carrier and latch every crossbar.
comparison.physical_skill: Route deformable cables side by side through twelve links, preserve order and strain relief, and snap repeated latches.
comparison.success_condition: Both cables correctly routed through all links, every crossbar latched, ends extended, released and still; tie-wrap slip fails.
comparison.reason: Cable routing and repeated snap-latching do not test size-selective passage of free rigid media or loaded-screen reseating.
